data.description:
## Bug Report

**Priority**: 4 (backlog)
**Zero Inference Rule**: Directly observed in diff for PR #337 by FP-recovery opus review.

## Observed behavior
test_ref_query_returns_auth_result_for_session_timeout in tests/scripts/test_corpus_anti_patterns.py invokes 'bash ref-query.sh "session timeout" --domain=auth', but ref-query.sh does not accept '--domain=' (only --top-n, --tier, --session-hash). The test is RED-marked in .test-index but the docstring rationale 'FAILS (RED): script absent and corpus absent' is now stale — the script and corpus both exist; the test fails because --domain filtering is not implemented.

## Expected behavior
RED-marked test docstrings accurately reflect why they fail.

## Fix
Either implement --domain filtering in ref-query.sh (proper fix) or update the docstring to 'FAILS (RED): --domain filter not yet implemented in ref-query.sh' to accurately describe the gap.
data.title: test_corpus_anti_patterns.py: stale RED docstring for --domain=auth test (feature missing, not script)
